notes:
Lead source: self-serve sign-up (hosted API).
Main product interest: Redwood Hosted API for lightweight POC and ramp to paid.
Primary persona: VP Support (Hannah Park) + Dev Lead (Ravi Patel).
Use-case details:
- Replace current heuristics that create tickets from inbound email with LLM-based summarization + structured output (JSON schema) to populate fields: priority, tags, suggested assignee.
- Tool calling: must be able to return a structured payload used by an internal webhook that calls Zendesk API (create/update ticket).
- Performance targets: 95th pctile latency <300ms for 256-token inference during business hours, batch/throughput need ~50 reqs/sec peak.
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget; ROI needs to show reduction in TTR and agent time. Looking at ~$1k-2k/mo initially.
Security & compliance:
- Public cloud ok for now; plan to revisit VPC/private for enterprise customers.
- Require SSO for console, SOC2 report, and audit logs for API key usage.
Quotes from call:
- "If we can autocreate accurate tickets and suggest tags 80%+ we can cut triage headcount" — Hannah Park (VP Support).
- "We prefer a hosted API to move quickly; give us a POC key and we'll run against real traffic" — Ravi Patel (Dev Lead).
Stubs/links: Fireflies ff_20260202_amberfall_intro, drive: pricing + security FAQ, jira SUPP-3124 for token spike investigation.
Pains: current rule-based parser misses context, creates duplicate tickets.
Probability/next: high interest — asked for POC key and JSON schema examples. Want to run 2-week POC (production traffic shadow).
timeline_summary: Discovery -> short hosted API POC -> evaluate performance/cost -> decide buy (SMB tier) or re-evaluate for Dedicated if scale requires
